journal.blurb: The smuggler meets a Vistula boatman in the docks-side alley. Something heavier than salt is coming up the river.

storylines.title: The delivery
storylines.note: The smuggler leaves the safe-house door to meet a Vistula boatman at the cart in the docks-side alley. Get within 3.5 m while they talk and they break off.

steps.text: Keep the cellar shut. I'll not be long.
Salt from Wieliczka, the manifest says. Under the salt, forty muskets.
And the customs man at the Vistula gate?
Paid till Candlemas. The barge leaves at the fourth bell.
Then the cellar takes them tonight. Go, before the watch comes round.
Not here. Walk on, friend.
steps.label: spooked

steps.text: Another night, then.

journal.blurb: The bishop's party walks to St Mary's for Compline, with an Austrian official at his elbow.

storylines.title: The procession
storylines.note: The bishop's party walks to St Mary's for Compline at 21:30 and comes out at 22:15. Their movement is their schedule; this adds the talk.

steps.text: Compline, gentlemen. Let us not keep the vicar waiting.
His Excellency the Governor sends his regards, Your Grace.
And his soldiers to count my congregation, I expect.
Mind the ice on the steps, Your Grace.
Your Grace. The doors are open.
Pray for Kraków. She will need it before spring.
Vienna prays for order, Your Grace. Order first.
The lantern, Your Grace. This way.

journal.blurb: A man in a grey coat shadows strangers between the Cloth Hall lanterns, and runs to the watch.

storylines.title: The informer
storylines.note: Pass within 8 m of the police informer, in his sight, and he shadows you at 6 m for two minutes, then reports you to the St Mary's post, who comes looking. Put 22 m between you and he loses you. If a false pamphlet was planted on him (Mission flag decoy_planted) he sends the corporal to the Florian Gate instead.

steps.text: Now who walks the Rynek after curfew?
Corporal! A stranger, skulking about the Cloth Hall. I followed him myself.
Corporal! Read this: Jacobins meeting at the Florian Gate, tonight. They're there now!
Show me.
The Florian Gate? Come on, then.
Gone. Devil take him.
steps.label: lost
